hypothesis: All four development executions satisfied both on predicates and preserved the already-true stove turnon predicate; rejection was solely because contact_v1_clean was false. The repeated failures were tied to the yaw-0 grid grasp: finger or tip contact occurred during descent, and palm or outer finger-link contact persisted during grasp, place, or retreat. I therefore changed only the grasp specification, replacing each grid with its exact object-specific registered demonstration grasp. Placement offsets, heights, tolerance, yaw, and pot2-then-pot1 order remain unchanged because they consistently achieved the official predicates without inter-object contact.
